verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's official MCP server is documented as letting an AI assistant 'update records' and 'move opportunities through your pipeline', and a REST API with deal endpoints and webhooks exists, so the core of an agent changing deal stages is first-party. Nothing in the evidence shows the agent ingesting email or meeting signals, or setting next steps such as activities. Missing for 10: documented email/meeting signal ingestion for the agent, explicit next-step/activity update support, deal-stage update endpoint detail, hands-on or independent corroboration of agent-driven pipeline updates.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent update deal stages and next steps from email and meeting signals via the API or MCP server

citations.quote: Find deals, update records, get insights, move opportunities through your pipeline and automate workflows, all from your AI assistant.
Pipedrive will send this notification as an HTTP `POST` request, with a JSON body, to the endpoint(s) you specify.
